_comment: Ground truth for the open-meteo recipe-lane dataset, captured AT THE SOURCE
with raw urllib — no engine, no httpx, no recipe machinery. A pipeline
checked against its own output proves only that it is self-consistent.
STABILITY IS WHY THIS SOURCE WAS CHOSEN. open-meteo's ARCHIVE endpoint is a
reanalysis of a PAST window, so a fixed lat/lon and a fixed date range
return the same bytes on every call — verified by hashing two consecutive
responses before this file was written. The FORECAST endpoint could not be
used: it is recomputed continuously and its allowed date range moves with
the current date, so no committed expectation could survive.
scaled_temp_sum_exact_int is the AUTHORITY: temperatures carry one decimal,
so round(t*10) is exact per value and integer addition is associative.
scaled_temp_sum corroborates only — summing float64 first is order-sensitive.
count_temp_null is 0 on this window. That is a real observation, not an
omission: it is why the conformance spec declares zero RF-002
discriminators WITH a stated reason, which yields SKIPPED-with-reason
